Business case · Launch planning

Syndicate AI

Evaluated an AI integration venture and used market, operations, finance and risk analysis to shape launch requirements.

My role
Business case and launch analysis
Period
2024
Project stage
Proposed venture

Business question

The proposed venture would help businesses adopt AI through integration and advisory services. The planning question was what it would take to offer and support those services.

Feasibility analysis

I contributed to a business plan covering market segments, positioning, service delivery, operations, marketing and sales, staffing, finance and risk. The plan explored a subscription model and considered how technology change and competition could affect delivery.

Launch requirements

The business case linked the target customer and service offer to the operating capabilities and financial assumptions needed to plan the launch. The outcome was a business plan and pitch for a proposed venture.

Where the analysis informs a decision

Positioning and customer selection define who needs the service. The operating model specifies the staffing and support needed to deliver it. Financial assumptions test whether recurring revenue can support the service. Risks such as fast-moving technology or competition become assumptions to revisit before committing to launch.
